note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.44-test, private edition (local test build, not the release). The public programs are fresh builds from each repository origin/main as of 2026-10-08 (NitroXide 0.4.1, VoXide 0.3.2, Half-Life main 8a7f220); Cortex Ignition is the console-tested 0.4b image; WipEout, Hollow Knight, Counter-Strike and the v1.27 hardware tests are the inputs of the v0.43 private pressing. Private, never published, never distributed.
